findings.title: AI-driven, large-scale nation-state campaign using ARTEX enables supply chain compromise
findings.summary_md: Storm-0940, a nation-state actor, used the ARTEX agentic AI platform to accelerate a ConnectWise supply chain compromise, enabling application credential abuse across customer environments. Microsoft describes ARTEX as an autonomous framework able to run an intrusion from reconnaissance through data exfiltration with minimal human interaction.

findings.title: What Is ARTEX? The AI Pentest Tool Turned Bank Hacker
findings.summary_md: Engineer Li Puhua, known online as Autumn, released ARTEX on GitHub as a personal side project for organizations to test their own networks. The article describes ARTEX as an AI pentesting tool later repurposed for bank hacking, and notes that ConnectWise issued its first advisory on 16 October 2026.

findings.title: ARTEX and Friends: Enter Agentic Offensive Frameworks
findings.summary_md: Mandiant and GTIG provide remediation guidance for intrusions driven by threat actors using ARTEX and similar agentic pentesting frameworks. Google Cloud characterizes ARTEX as an autonomous, multi-agent LLM-driven pentesting and offensive command-and-control platform written in Go with an embedded Next.js web console.
